task: M2 2D exploratory L3 + side-coupled W1 S21 ladder (summary)

L3.s_star_note: 2D-model optimum (max Q_2d); the 3D radiation-Q optimum ~0.15a is an AT-2 (out-of-scope) result

Qw_exponential_fit.note: N=2 excluded: its coupled mode is pushed to nu0=0.2743 (out of guided-band overlap), so it is anomalously weakly coupled

coupling_band: L3 fundamental (Hz odd-x, even-y) couples to the 2nd (even) W1 guided band; the 1st band is parity-forbidden
TCMT_identity: on-res T=(gamma_i/(gamma_i+gamma_w))^2=(Q_w/(Q_i+Q_w))^2; A=2 Q_i Q_w/(Q_i+Q_w)^2; verified algebraically per N in 'ladder'
twoD_caveat: The 2D W1 is MULTIMODE across the gap; the L3 mode-converts band2<->band1 and radiates, so a clean single-mode standing-wave notch/mirror does NOT form in 2D (mode-resolved band-2 reflection <0.07 on resonance). Q_w,Q_i are from harminv ring-down (coupled vs waveguide-capped). The clean TCMT S21 notch and T_min<0.05 mirror require the single-mode 3D slab W1 (AT-3, out of M2-2D scope).
